## Checklist

- [ ] `python3 scripts/validate.py --strict` passes locally.
- [ ] A stage change cites a primary source in the record's `timeline` and `sources`, and the `history` array has a dated note explaining it.
- [ ] Wording is neutral: alignment with the document, never causation; no position on whether the recommendation is good or bad.
- [ ] No em dashes; URLs are https with no spaces; dates are YYYY-MM-DD.
- [ ] No names or personal details of private people.
- [ ] I signed off my commits (`git commit -s`, the Developer Certificate of Origin).
